name: Hai Van Pass
kicker: The coast pass between Da Nang and Hue
summary: Cross the pass when the sky is clear, by car or with a licensed rider. The road and the sea are the point. No ticket was found for the road. Tunnel and hire charges are check on arrival. The train to Hue is about three hours if you would rather not drive. Do not ride it in cloud.
timeNeeded: Half a day as a detour
getThere: North from Da Nang by car or a licensed rider. Road minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The pass road, with the sea in the same frame

notice.title: Go only when the sky is clear
notice.body: Cloud hides the sea, which is the reason to take the pass. September to December is the heavy-rain and storm window on the city climate pages. The train skips the pass.

body: Hai Van is the coast road north, between Da Nang and Hue. Go by car or with a licensed rider, and only on a clear day. You want the road and the sea in one view. It is a detour, not a city sight, and not a required stop on the way to the airport.

No ticket for the road was found. Treat the road as free, and check any tunnel or hire charge on arrival. A published drive time from Da Nang to Hue over the pass was not found either. Those minutes stay check on arrival.

If the sky is wrong, take the train. On the Vietnam Railways board, SE3 leaves Hue at 07:55 and reaches Da Nang at 10:43, about three hours. Other trains differ. The rail does not use the pass. The second photograph is the cloud day: the road is there, and the sea is not. That is the day to skip.

figures.caption: The same road in cloud, with the sea missing. Skip this day.
figures.alt: Hai Van Pass in cloud, the road visible and the sea hidden

gettingThere: The pass is north of Da Nang, on the coast road toward Hue. Go by car or with a licensed rider. No official page used here prints the road minutes. The train is the sourced alternative.

legs.heading: From Da Nang
legs.body: North by car or a licensed rider, in clear weather. The minutes over the pass are check on arrival.

legs.heading: If you skip the pass
legs.body: The train between Hue and Da Nang is about three hours on the published SE3 times, Hue 07:55 to Da Nang 10:43. Other trains differ. The timetable changes.

hours: Daylight, and only when the sky is clear. No gate hour is published.
closed: Do not ride it in cloud. September to December is the heavy-rain and storm window.
admissionNote: No road ticket was found. Tunnel fees and rider hire are check on arrival. No number was copied.
